title: potentilla aurea subvar. pusilla
intro: Potentilla aurea subvar. pusilla, commonly known as Dwarf or Small Golden Potentilla, is a shrub-like perennial plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is used to treat various conditions, such as wounds, burns, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla aurea subvar. pusilla include antiseptic, antiviral, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
